mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased by more than 100k over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPI) rises above 3.5% year-over-year for two consecutive months, it indicates accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL has exceeded 3.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has risen and UNRATE has fallen over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and rise in industrial production indicates weakening consumer demand relative to supply, signaling potential economic slowdown and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has declined and INDPRO has risen over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in the federal funds rate from the previous month signals a policy pivot toward easing, reducing hard landing risk and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined during a monetary tightening cycle, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market overheating regime, a decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals excessive labor demand that increases wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has fallen below 3.5% during a labor market overheating regime, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
